Writing Just for Fun

For anyone who used to love writing, or never felt allowed to try. Each day is one small, low pressure way to play with words, from short poems and silly lists to tiny stories and descriptions, written for no one but you.

Creativity · Self-Care · Mindfulness · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Write a three line poem about today's weather, using only what you can see from the nearest window.
  • Day 2Write five sentences about the room you are sitting in, one for each thing you notice first.
  • Day 3Write a six sentence story about an umbrella that gets lost on a rainy afternoon and where it finally ends up.
  • Day 4List ten names for a cloud you can see, from the very grand to the completely ridiculous.
  • Day 5Set a timer for five minutes and write about anything at all until it rings, then stop happily.
  • Day 6Make up a short rhyme about a pet you know, yours, a friend's or the dog next door.
  • Day 7Describe the smell of fall in three sentences, as if no one had ever smelled it before.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Scribble a tiny tale on the back of a receipt before it goes in the recycling, or keep it if you like it.
  • Day 60Choose a cozy writing corner at home and make it inviting with a cushion, a blanket and a good pen.
  • Day 120Sharpen every pencil you own, then use the sharpest one for a short burst of playful writing.
  • Day 240Use a sticky note as your page today, fitting a whole tiny idea into that small square.
  • Day 365Write a whole page in very tiny handwriting, as if for a mouse, and admire how small it looks.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
